# Web performance and SEO
- Measure before optimizing; inspect bundle size, loading waterfall, rendering, and Core Web Vitals.
- Prioritize LCP, INP, CLS, caching, compression, image sizing, and code splitting.
- Lazy-load below-the-fold media and avoid shipping heavy libraries for minor effects.
- Use semantic titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, robots directives, sitemap, and structured data when appropriate.
- Ensure metadata reflects actual content and never keyword-stuff.
- Verify production build and test on mobile/network constraints.
